patch.value: pm brief diverge: pre-merge multi-agent item collision preview

Adds 'pm brief diverge' subcommand that previews pm item divergence between two git branches BEFORE merging. Shows which items both branches touched and whether the field-aware merge driver will resolve them cleanly (union-safe) or produce a real conflict (field-collision, duplicate-id, delete-vs-edit). Includes a fence check for .gitattributes/git-config merge driver installation. Supports markdown/text/json/slack formats with deterministic ordering and token budgeting.

pm brief diverge previews divergence between base/head git refs: classifies each touched pm item as head-only, base-only, union-safe, field-collision, duplicate-id, or delete-vs-edit; checks merge driver fence (.gitattributes + git config); supports --base/--head/--include-clean/--max-items/--token-budget/--format/--output; deterministic ordering (duplicate-id > delete-vs-edit > field-collision > union-safe > one-sided), tie-break by id; markdown/text/json/slack renderers; pure functions exported and unit-tested; one end-to-end integration test with real git repo; npm run typecheck/build/test pass.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Implemented pm brief diverge: git readers (resolveRepoRoot, resolveRef, detectDefaultBase, mergeBase, listChangedPaths, readBlob), path model (pmRootRelFromCtx), event identity (parseHistoryJsonl, eventKey, newEvents, countMalformedLines), field extraction (changedFieldPaths, normalizeFieldPath, BENIGN_FIELDS), per-item classification (classifyItemDivergence: 6 kinds — head-only, base-only, unchanged, duplicate-id, delete-vs-edit, field-collision, union-safe), fence check (evaluateFence), aggregate (buildDivergence: verdict precedence, deterministic ordering, token budget), 4 renderers (markdown/text/json/slack), command registration with all flags. 27 unit tests + 1 end-to-end integration test (real git repo + real pm CLI). Gates: typecheck OK, build OK, 86/86 tests pass, changelog:check OK. Production proof: ran all 4 formats against a real divergent git repo — verdict review-required, item1 field-collision on /metadata/status, item2 union-safe (priority vs assignee), item3 base-only.
